For the skill in

“You're a human metal detector.”— Perk card description

**Fortune Finder** is a Perception-based perk in *Fallout 76*.

With this perk, a directional audio clue is played whenever a caps stash is nearby.

| Rank | Cost | Description | Form ID | 
| ★ | 1 | You hear directional audio when in range of a Caps Stash. | 00518504 |
